section.45: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

45.name_native: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet said:"If a person were to look at you without permission and you were to throw a stone at him and put out his eye, there would be no blame on you
